issues.description: The problem statement and UML explicitly require Farm.animals to be a List<Animal> and instruct students to initialize an ArrayList in the no-arg constructor, but the provided solution implements the field as a Set<Animal> (HashSet). This mismatch between the specified collection type (List/ArrayList) and the solution's Set/HashSet can confuse students about the intended data structure and could cause inconsistencies if tests or instructions expect List-specific behavior or ordering.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution (and template) with the problem statement by changing the Farm.animals field to a List<Animal> and initializing it with new ArrayList<>() in the no-argument constructor. Alternatively, if a Set is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to specify a Set/HashSet so all artifacts agree.
